annotations.title: In conſummation of the tabernacle.
annotations.text: The ſeuentie Interpreters teſtifie by adding this title, [1]that king Dauid made this Pſalme (as he did alſo ſome others) when the Arke of God was brought into the tabernacle, [2]which he had pitched for it in Sion. 2. Reg. 6. 1. Paral. 16. VVherin he ſaw by prophetical ſpirite, and here vttereth other farre greater myſteries, & more excellent benefites, brought into the world by Chriſt, and preached by him, and his Apoſtles, then agreed to the Arke, or the time of the old Teſtament; but are verified in the admirable fruite of innumerable people of al nations, and of manie great Potentates conuerted to Chriſtianitie.

notes.text: Mysteries of the Catholique Church prophecied in this Psalme.
